sentences.en: The auditors will have a hard time deciphering this ledger.
sentences.zh: 审计人员要费一番功夫才能理清这笔账。

sentences.en: Beauty is that marvelous mystery that neither psychology nor rhetoric deciphers.
sentences.zh: 美丽是心理学和修辞学都无法破解的奇妙之谜。

sentences.en: Unhurriedly, patiently, he managed to decipher the tiny writing.
sentences.zh: 他不急不躁，耐心地解开了这些小字的秘密。

senses.zh: 解释（过去式deciphered，过去分词deciphered，现在分词deciphering，第三人称单数deciphers，名词decipherer，形容词decipherable）；译解

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de（去掉）+cipher（密码）→解开密码→破译
